The latest single from the forthcoming album

The singer released a new single from the forthcoming Day and Night album. The accompanying video follows the performer through a dining room after a party. The artist introduced the record last month with its first single, and the complete twenty-four-track album is scheduled to arrive in September through the performer's longtime label.

The video was directed by a frequent collaborator and uses the aftermath of the gathering to establish the song's setting. The release continues a rollout that will include additional music before the album arrives. Readers can revisit an earlier interview with the performer for more background on the new project.
